alibabacloud-oss-deletion-recovery-diagnosis 0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides read-only diagnosis for Alibaba Cloud OSS accidental deletion and deletion residue scenarios.
- Determines recoverability based on bucket versioning status and official OSS policy.
- Explains delete markers, leftover fragments, and unchanging capacity/cost after deletions.
- Strictly prohibits any write actions or outputting mutating commands/scripts.
- All diagnostics performed via controlled entry scripts, never via direct OSS API calls.
- Cites only officially-verified OSS documentation; never fabricates URLs or recovery promises.
